stable.headline: Enter goes into Edit mesh, Edit mesh and Undo work together, and the viewport no longer stalls after editing.
notes: Enter goes into Edit mesh and out of it.
Edit mesh and Undo / Redo work together.
The viewport no longer stalls after editing.
The materials list, the card in Properties and the colour dots in the tree agree at once.
Heavy parts: no replaying bars, and its ticks are its own.
The colour picker can be moved.
